About Nora’s Upholstery

Our Story

For more than 40 years, Nora’s Upholstery has brought careful, hands-on craftsmanship to pieces used every day. What began with traditional upholstery experience now serves dental and medical practices, homes, restaurants, gyms and other businesses across the GTA and Southern Ontario.

We approach every project by listening first, understanding how the piece is used and selecting a finish that respects both its purpose and the people who rely on it. Clinical work remains a specialty, supported by the same attention to fit, durability and finish that we bring to residential and commercial furniture.

Please call or email before visiting so we can arrange a time and prepare for your project.

Quick facts

  • • More than 40 years of experience
  • • Weekend rush for dental
  • • Pickup and delivery across the GTA
  • • Loaner chiropractic bed on request

Inside the craft

The chair is our digital signature. The needle is our maker’s mark and a quiet reminder that every project is finished by hand.
